page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r9ae.xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 4 dedicated vCPUs based on the x86_64 architecture, utilizing AMD EPYC 9T95 processors operating at a base frequency of 2.25 GHz. The instance is configured with 32.0 GB of system memory, providing a high memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per vCPU.

This instance does not include local storage or integrated GPU hardware, meaning all storage requirements must be met through network-attached block storage. It provides a baseline network bandwidth of 4 Gbps. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures that the 4 vCPUs deliver consistent compute performance without resource contention from other tenants on the host.

Given its high memory density of 8.0 GB per vCPU, the ecs.r9ae.xlarge is designed for memory-intensive workloads. It is suitable for hosting medium-sized databases, caching layers, enterprise applications, and memory-bound data processing tasks that do not require local NVMe storage or GPU acceleration.
